newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Telinfo shareholders place 30 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Telinfo shareholders place 30 pct stake.

text.p: Belgian telecommunications group Telinfo said on Thursday two of its shareholders had sold a total of about 30 percent in Telinfo to a consortium lead by Merrill Lynch International.
It said the sale was a prelude to a capital increase in the autumn of this year.
The operation would double the liquidity of Telinfo shares from 31 percent to 60.42 percent.
Sidinvest NV sold 24.30 percent, Brussimmo NV 5.12 percent, to the consortium, which is co-lead by KB Securities and Hongkong Shangai Investment Bank, for replacement with institutional investors.
"The sale occurs under the suspensive condition of the listing of the sold shares on the first market at the Stock Exchange of Brussels," Telinfo said in its statement.

It said the capital increase in the autumn would raise the cash for planned takeovers in France and Spain. Existing shareholders in principle agreed to subscribe to and pay in the capital increase in proportion of their stakes.
The conditions of the capital increase would be announced in the autumn.
The financing of the further expansion of Telinfo would be supported by existing shareholders, the statement said.
